structural_validation.validation_note: The amended E3=1/E2=4/E1=7 packet set passed branch-head no-inference contract validation on this commit. The validator verifies packet structure, nesting and hashes only; semantic sufficiency and final case acceptance remain separate project-lead decisions.

semantic_review.adjudication_route: v0.2 exploratory; single source-aware project-lead technical adjudicator, matching the Dishka #435 accepted precedent
semantic_review.project_lead_role: sole human decision-maker for technical gold mechanism, alternatives and E1/E2/E3 tier membership/sufficiency; full source exposure disclosed
semantic_review.chatgpt_role: AI advisory critique only; never counted as a human reviewer or adjudicator
semantic_review.hasan_role: project-lead-reported supplementary source-aware technical input only; not a separate signed independent adjudication, blinded review or inter-rater statistic
semantic_review.rationale: The active v0.2 protocol and accepted Dishka precedent do not require two blind reviewers or a third adjudicator for gold/E1/E2/E3. The two-human Rater A/Rater B requirement applies to later blinded scoring of raw model-output evidence support, not to source-aware gold/tier construction.
semantic_review.sufficiency_caution: The project lead may judge E1 insufficient; if so, do not force a unique-cause tier or accept this as a three-tier case. Structural validation is not semantic sufficiency.
semantic_review.output_scoring_gate: Two independent human scorers are still required for model-output evidence-support scoring before any such ratings; Rater B consent, case-specific exposure screening and calibration remain pending.

project_lead_gold_decision.decision_source: Explicit project-lead approval in ChatGPT conversation
project_lead_gold_decision.approved_gold_mechanism_tr: MCMC.run(), warmup sonrasında saklanan sampler durumundaki skaler PRNG anahtarını vektörleştirilmiş zincirler için oluşturulan anahtar dizisiyle değiştiriyor. EnsembleSampler.sample() ise bu alanı skaler kabul ederek random.split() çağırıyor. Hata, sampler durumundaki anahtar biçiminin bu iki aşama arasında tutarsız hale gelmesinden kaynaklanıyor.
project_lead_gold_decision.scope: The exact technical gold mechanism is approved. This does not approve the proposed E1/E2/E3 membership or sufficiency, alternative-hypothesis disposition, license scope, exposure declaration, complete case record, or final case acceptance.

candidate_selection_decision.scope: Candidate selection for continued Stage 3 evaluation only; not final case acceptance.

packet_membership_construction_decision.decision_source: Explicit project-lead approval in ChatGPT conversation
packet_membership_construction_decision.scope: Approval is limited to adding the two exact pinned buggy-base MCMC API-contract excerpts to E2 and E1 and preparing the requested nested packet structure. It does not establish semantic sufficiency, close alternative-hypothesis adjudication, accept the candidate, or authorize model inference.

limitations: Structural validity does not establish causal entailment or semantic tier sufficiency.
For source-code items, source_snapshot_sha256 binds the exact verbatim excerpt snapshot; parent files are separately anchored by immutable upstream commit and Git blob SHA-1.

The project lead and Hasan have seen candidate source/design material; neither is eligible for blinded raw-response scoring for this case. This does not prevent the project lead's source-aware gold/tier decision under the Dishka-equivalent exploratory method.
Two-human independent scoring remains required for raw model responses; that role is distinct from technical gold/E1/E2/E3 adjudication.
The proposed E1 initialization excerpt strengthens the causal chain but still requires explicit project-lead source-aware sufficiency decision.
